evaluation_rules.principle_1: Assignment must be based on measured ODD physical dimensions, not visual scene semantics.
evaluation_rules.principle_2: Clutter, machines, presses, and dark clothing do not constitute ODD_SHIFT unless mapped to a defined ODD metric.
evaluation_rules.principle_3: If physical sensor telemetry is absent, dimension status must be UNKNOWN, not inferred IN_ODD or OUT_OF_ODD.

camera_height_status.evidence_note: No extrinsic physical survey or ceiling mount log exists on disk.

pitch_status.odd_specification: 30.0 deg to 55.0 deg (Model H step at 40.0 deg)
pitch_status.evidence_note: No inclinometer telemetry or extrinsic calibration matrix available.

range_status.evidence_note: Estimated target distances fall entirely within operational perception range.

floor_geometry_status.evidence_note: Visual appearance indicates concrete floor, but metric planar survey is absent.

illumination_status.evidence_note: Photometric lux meter logs are completely absent.

speed_status.evidence_note: Observed forklift transit speed is within normal warehouse operational limits.

latency_status.evidence_note: ByteTrack + YOLO26n inference runs in real-time.

uncertainty_width_status.evidence_note: Because runtime Model H implementation was flawed and lux/pitch unmeasured, uncertainty width cannot be certified.

identity_status.measurement: 4 track IDs for 1 vehicle over 6.98s (173 frames)
identity_status.odd_specification: Track fragmentation < 1 per 10s of unoccluded transit
identity_status.evidence_note: Single moving forklift fragmented into track IDs [1, 5, 9, 12], exhibiting unacceptable identity fragmentation.

governing_rationale: Key extrinsic dimensions (camera height, tilt pitch, illumination lux) are completely unmeasured. In accordance with Section 6, IN_ODD cannot be inferred without demonstration. Therefore, overall status is UNKNOWN.
